story_sequence.text: Test Contract Index exposes identity, truth refs, runtime/docs lines, lane membership, AC/TC/test/evidence mapping, status, and reason codes.
Canonical lanes include feature release-facing, current runtime contract, generated surface sync, compatibility contract, and legacy snapshot.
Release-facing tests without AC/TC/evidence mapping are blocked unless classified as generated-surface contract checks.
Doctor support surface builds and verifies test contract index without adding a public lifecycle stage.
QA lane execution preserves AC order, evidence pack, coverage current/gap, continue decision, blocker stop, repair handoff, help resume, and backfill.
Release scorecard and strict gate consume lane status and block missing, stale, failed, or unclassified release-facing evidence.
Generated skill, metadata, command, context, and agent surfaces are lane-classified and block delivery when drift affects truth or routing.
Historical snapshot failures route to legacy snapshot or test evolution backlog unless promoted to active compatibility contract.
Beacon skills instruct agents to use contract-lane verification and avoid unclassified full-suite release claims.
Deep test deltas route through test-case or supplemental QA; deep remains support-only and does not execute QA.
Freezing v1.4.2 requirement materials does not change current runtime release line, docs default line, or package version.
Test contract governance blockers include reason codes and repair or resume routes through existing support surfaces.
